about: every way the UI pipeline makes a picture (a PIECE ROUTE), what it is for, and the owner's record on it. kit/ui/routes.py names each piece's route from its sidecar / provenance; kit ui plan shows a screen's pieces by route and stops a hero piece on a graveyard route; kit ui vault writes library/ui/ROUTES.md (this table + how many pieces each route made). status: golden (the owner's best verdicts came from it) | ok | caution (fine for small parts, never the hero) | graveyard (the owner rejected it: never again as a hero piece)

trace.make: lune run kit ui trace <identity>/<piece> --from <still> --box x,y,w,h
trace.for: a replica of a real piece: 1:1 crop -> x4 -> matte -> cells + anchors

letter.make: "lettering" on a label (kit ui words) or lune run kit ui letter <identity>/<piece> --text ...
letter.for: display words: a face per glyph, outline, rim, lean, inline, arc, drips, glow
letter.evidence: Arcade5Title / Arcade5Menu 92: owner 'GENUINELY AMAZED' once the lettering became the grammar (2026-10-11)

ink.make: lune run kit ui ink <identity>/<piece> --from <real picture> --mode ink|cel|icon
ink.for: a REAL character / object picture through an ink pipeline
ink.evidence: official 2D key art through --mode cel 'read at once' after a FLUX stand-in was 'looks bad' (2026-10-11)

render.make: lune run kit ui render <identity>/<piece>   (text, ring, gauge, gem, dial items)
render.for: an original logotype / plate / gem / dial with real light
render.evidence: one rendered piece moved two screens over 75 after four PIL rounds plateaued 63-74 (2026-10-15)

smear.for: a motion-smeared character card, a frame break

digits.make: lune run kit ui letter <identity>/<set> --text 8 --glyphs 0123456789 ... -> a "type": "number" node
digits.for: the numbers that change, drawn not typed
digits.evidence: every judge round: 'the numeral is a stock typed label' -> digit sets (2026-10-15)

spin.for: 3D accents: a logo turning, a card flip, an emblem landing
spin.evidence: InkModes' 3D flip, the Strive logo relief

icon.make: lune run kit ui icon find "<words>" / icon make (game-icons.net, CC BY, credited) or the kit's own 3D renders

plate.make: the identity's shape language, drawn by kit ui plates at build time
plate.for: frames, pills, slots, grain, vignettes — the furniture, never the hero
plate.evidence: plates alone read as 'AI slop' every time they were the whole screen

concept.make: lune run kit vision concept "<prompt>" -> kit vision cutout
concept.for: ORIGINAL motifs only (a pet, a potion); never a known character or logo
concept.evidence: a FLUX Heroine stand-in: 'looks bad' — use the real picture through ink (2026-10-11)

drawn.make: a _scratch generator script (PIL) with a PROVENANCE.md row
drawn.for: small pieces measured from the stills (ticks, tape, splatter); never polish a hero piece here
drawn.evidence: four PIL rounds plateaued 63-74; 'never polish with PIL' (mission 03, section 14)

typed.for: small text and the small numbers that change; NEVER the hero piece
typed.evidence: the first character-action HUD from memory, typed glyphs + flat tints: 'GENUINE AI SLOP' (2026-10-10); a typed hero piece is a compile error now

unknown.make: — name it: a sidecar or a PROVENANCE.md row
unknown.for: nothing: a picture with no source cannot be trusted or redone
unknown.evidence: the vault rule: every piece names where it came from
